title: proper-place
description: Rebinds left-click to break and right-click to place blocks in the oldest minecraft version. Because that's how it should be.
body:
# proper-place

## About
This mod rebinds the controls for placing and breaking blocks.
It is made for the first ever minecraft versions, rd-132211 and rd-132328

### Old:
- left-click: place 
- right-click: break

### New:
- left-click: break
- right-click: place

## Purpose
The earliest versions have no keybind settings... or settings menu... or pretty much anything else.
Regardless, if you want to play them, this mod should help it align to your muscle memory.

## Installation 
1. Create a new Prism instance for version rd-132211 or rd-132328
2. Edit -> Version -> Add to Minecraft.jar
3. Select proper-place.jar
4. Enjoy?

## Compatibility
This is compatible with Kilobyte Night's Ancient Planks mod (im not aware of any other mods made for this version), so place planks with right click to your heart's content!
